files.title: Building an inventory

files.title: Creating a playbook
files.summary:
Playbooks are automation blueprints, in `YAML` format, that Ansible uses to deploy and configure managed nodes.

Playbook

A list of plays that define the order in which Ansible performs operations, from top to bottom, to achieve an overall goal.

Play

An ordered list of tasks that maps to managed nodes in an inventory.

Task

A reference to a single module that defines the operations that Ansible performs.

Module

A unit of code or binary that Ansible runs on managed nodes.

## Magic variables

These variables cannot be set directly by the user; Ansible will always override them to reflect internal state.

ansible\_check\_mode

Boolean that indicates if we are in check mode or not

ansible\_collection\_name

The name of the collection the task that is executing is a part of.
